exact_rule: Public processed data remain non-confirmatory; confirmatory cultures must be new and excluded from pilot tuning. No old gate is reinterpreted.

Sequence identity and assay standards pass; nascent error increase has a positive lower 95% CI in ED NVA vs ED NONE and an ED-specific exposure increment; primary spectrum is distinguishable. Otherwise no causal-error primary.

Functional ADD HIGH increment is positive with a lower 95% CI; equivalence CIs for machine-induced differences in nascent errors/spectrum, reporter synthesis, growth and REP toxicity lie inside independently locked margins. Otherwise only total perturbation effects are interpretable.

Capture specificity/preservation, linear range, blank, mass-balance and precursor QC pass frozen numerical limits; primary reporter association above validated quantification limit. Failure means primary mechanistic observable not identifiable; do not substitute aggregates.

Pilot-only variance, delta, equivalence margins, doses, timings, panel, QC limits, n and allocation/code hashes frozen before new confirmatory cultures. If feasible n cannot resolve delta, stop for feasibility.

All earlier gates pass: upper 95% CI(Theta)<−delta supports the bounded sign hypothesis; lower CI>−delta rejects a reduction of at least delta; lower CI>0 is an opposite-sign falsifier. Otherwise inconclusive.

Reduction in association is called productive relief only if pulse-cohort functional yield is identifiable through an independent pulse-cohort activity assay or a validated conditional synthesis-stop preserving physiology, with validated error-dependent specific activity, an independently supported increase in new-native yield and no explanation solely by synthesis suppression, degradation, death or failed recovery. Otherwise association relief only; no new-native yield claim when pulse-cohort functional yield is UNIDENTIFIABLE.
